Why a group ride directory on a mental-health site

A group ride is the cheapest, most reliable way I know to get out of my own head and into a room of people who want you there. Nobody asks what you do. You just ride. This directory exists so that anyone, anywhere in the country, can find one this week.

How this list is built. Every ride is real and recurring, checked against its own website, Instagram, Facebook or Strava page. Each page shows the date it was last checked and the sources. Rides we couldn't fully confirm are marked "Unconfirmed". Know one we're missing, or run one that's listed? Tell us on Instagram. Last checked: 2026-09-15.

I'm riding 10,000 miles in 2027 for queer mental health. Pledge a mile if you want to back it. Or just go find your ride.

If you're struggling: the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline is free and 24/7 — call or text 988. For LGBTQ youth, the Trevor Project is at 1-866-488-7386 (or text START to 678-678).
